snippet.title: Rolling Line - PC Gameplay
snippet.description:
You can play Rolling Line on PC with mouse and keyboard controls. Build custom tracks, drive trains and explore a huge detailed miniature table-top railway!

Rolling Line is coming to Steam on April 27th for the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and on PC.

The Steam store page for Rolling Line is already live! 
Follow/wishlist the game to get news and updates:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/754150/Rolling_Line/

:: More info and media on the Gaugepunk Games website:
http://www.gaugepunk.com/

:: Follow Gaugepunk Games on Twitter or daily development news!
https://twitter.com/gaugepunk

:: And on Facebook!
https://www.facebook.com/gaugepunk
